acceptance_contract.group_atomicity: Only a complete ES/EN desktop/mobile matrix can be integrated; incomplete groups remain external.
acceptance_contract.png: Native captured bytes, SHA256 bound, CRC and P3 checked, no pixel edits or upsampling.
acceptance_contract.runtime: New read-only capture contract; no option selection, Confirm, step edit, save, publish or automation mutation.
acceptance_contract.article_changes: Insert accepted figures only at unique exact anchors; stripping those blocks must restore source bytes. Headings/links/stubs unchanged.
acceptance_contract.build_and_pixels: Current build, two emitted source copies, responsive source selection/4x/native display limits, alt and actual page pixels required; old build results do not transfer.
acceptance_contract.inventory: Only the two article rows change from pending to in_progress during preparation; total45 unresolved remains. No complete status from catalog/menu coverage.
acceptance_contract.claims: Each caption is bounded to visible controls; no action outcome or saved/active state inferred.
acceptance_contract.visual_scope: Card frames and identifying descriptions, and an open trigger-list container with visible initial options. Explicit native ribbon/internal-scroll limits are accepted; do not claim full AI title in ES mobile or complete trigger inventory.

conditions: Trigger caption explicitly precedes choosing/confirmation because original numbered list ends with Confirm.
Open-list caption requires actual open dropdown pixels; closed pane is not equivalent.
No creation, activation, AI execution or saved-state claim from catalog.

catalog_redundancy_decision.rule: Conversion and DIY catalog scenes have different target cards and article anchors; both are retained in the visual contract. No redundant screenshot quota.

help_write_scope: Workrecords, plans, Custom originals and two ledger rows only; four bodies and both stubs unchanged.
